text:
harper: spotted plaintext DB URI in a partner chart upload to staging charts: gs://redwood-staging-charts/partner-chart-ingest/0.5.0/values.yaml -> DB_URL=postgresql://ingest_svc:badpass@staging-db:5432/ingest

samir: yikes. Which upload method? did it bypass our ingest pipeline?

harper: partner pushed directly with their SA. I copied file to gs://evidence-store/SEC-3742001111/values.yaml and removed public ACL.

tess: initial triage: staging-only so far. Plan: (1) quarantine object, (2) revoke partner SA write, (3) rotate DB creds and write new creds to Vault, (4) check Vault for wrapped blobs referencing vault-wrapkey-v1 and plan rewrap.

oncall: applying IAM change: removing roles/storage.objectCreator from partner-ci@partner.iam for gs://redwood-staging-charts/* and granting write to quarantine-bucket.

ops-bot: IAM change applied by oncall at 3742001130 - partner-ci@partner.iam no longer has objectCreator on staging charts.

samir: harper run a quick logs grep for the old username `ingest_svc` and flag any external IPs.

harper: running: `gcloud logging read 'textPayload:"ingest_svc"' --limit=200` -> results show internal cluster IPs only so far.

tess: luca/ops: please rotate creds now. Use ephemeral user pattern `ingest_svc_rot_<ts>`, write to Vault at secret/data/staging/db/ingest_svc_rot. Mark old secret deprecated (do not delete). Canary via ConfigSync to 1 pod. Revoke old creds after 30m if canary healthy.

samir: also snapshot audit logs before touching any wrapped blobs: `gcloud logging read 'logName="projects/redwood/logs/cloudaudit.googleapis.com%2Fdata_access"' --format=json > /tmp/audit-snap.json` and upload to evidence-store.

harper: found Vault entries under secret/partner-chart-ingest referencing wrapped_blob -> references vault-wrapkey-v1. We will provision a rewrap key alias `rewrap-temp-3742` and run controlled rewrap if needed.

ops-bot: rotate script executed at 3742001145: `created user ingest_svc_rot_3742001145` and new creds written to `secret/data/staging/db/ingest_svc_rot_3742001145`.

security-bot: Canary triggered via ConfigSync at 3742001152 targeting staging (1 pod). Monitor for auth errors >5% in 10m.

harper: canary pod connected successfully. Monitoring 15m. No decrypt failures so far.

samir: ok proceed with (A) revoke old DB creds at 3742001200 if canary still healthy, (B) run rewrap utility `tools/kv-rewrap --from=vault-wrapkey-v1 --to=rewrap-temp-3742` during maintenance window, (C) run full scan across partner buckets for similar plaintexts, (D) follow up with partner on secure upload flow and server-side scanning.

oncall: partner CI attempted a new upload and it landed in quarantine-bucket; no plaintext detected.

ops-bot: old DB user revoked at 3742001200. Audit snapshot uploaded to gs://evidence-store/SEC-3742001111/audit-snap.json.

harper: rewrap run started and completed with zero decrypt failures observed. Post-rewrap audit snapshot uploaded.

security-bot: SEC-3742001111 update: rotation + rewrap complete, partner SA write restricted, canary healthy. Follow-ups assigned: infra (add server-side secret scanning), partner-security (update onboarding checklist).

tess: I'll draft a short retro + partner runbook and link it here when ready.

samir: thanks all. Closing this thread after retro posted.
